completion_data.completion_summary: Simplified state update pipeline to state.json-first with TODO.md regeneration via generate-todo.sh. Replaced link-artifact-todo.sh calls across 14 files (scripts, skills, extension skills, documentation) with generate-todo.sh calls. Added PIPELINE_MODE guard and deprecation logging in update-task-status.sh for safe rollback.

memory_candidates.content: When replacing link-artifact-todo.sh calls across a codebase, also check .claude/extensions/core/skills/ in addition to .claude/skills/ — both directories contain separate active SKILL.md files that need to be updated independently.

The PIPELINE_MODE environment variable pattern enables safe rollback during script migrations: PIPELINE_MODE=new (default) uses new logic; PIPELINE_MODE=legacy falls back to old code. Add deprecation logging only in the legacy path so normal operation produces no log noise. Test log creation with: PIPELINE_MODE=legacy bash script.sh --dry-run
